device.name: Sensirion SHT3x / SHT4x / MyCO2 BLE Gadgets
device.notes:
Passive manufacturer-specific advertisements under Bluetooth company ID 0x06D5 carry current measurements without a connection, account, Wi-Fi, or cloud. The two type bytes are advertisement type 00 followed by sample type 04, 06, or 08. All tick and CO2 fields are unsigned 16-bit little-endian values. The two bytes at offset 2 are an opaque device ID, not a model number, proof of identity, or value to byte-swap for display.
This is deliberately not the legacy SHT31 Smart Gadget / Smart Humigadget spec. That older design uses separate float32 GATT characteristics and the f234 logger; no newer manufacturer-sample format is attributed to it.
While a gadget is connected to one GATT client, Sensirion's current public specification says it sends no advertisements and is invisible to other clients. A passive reader must therefore tolerate gaps while another client is connected and resume decoding after disconnect; it must not fill a gap with a zero measurement.

openness.notes: Sensirion publishes the protocol and reference implementations. Where the current web tables, older PDF, and current Arduino implementation differ, this spec keeps the generation and its evidence visible rather than selecting one silently.

enter_pairing_mode.notes: No family-wide pairing-mode procedure is established; passive reception does not enter pairing at all.

exclusivity.recovery: Close or disconnect the other GATT client and scan again after the gadget resumes advertising. Do not perform an OTA/reboot write to make a device reappear.

pairing.notes: Pairing is definitely unnecessary for passive advertisements. It is not honest to extend that answer to every product's GATT, settings, or OTA surface: current app behavior is product/firmware-specific and no pairing operation was attempted. One connected central at a time is the documented family behavior.

unpair.notes: No family-wide bond-clearing procedure is established.

credentials.notes: No credential is needed for the documented passive path; no family-wide GATT credential is claimed.

factory_reset.description: Do not generalize a board-specific reboot, OTA, settings, or history operation into a reset. No candidate physical reset is published here.
factory_reset.effect: No family-wide factory-reset procedure or effect is established. Changing a supported logger interval erases logged samples, but that is a destructive settings write, not a factory reset.

methods.description: Scan for company 0x06D5 and one of the three declared type prefixes; no connection is made.
methods.name: Passive manufacturer-data readings

steps.action: Passively scan manufacturer-specific advertisement data for company ID 0x06D5.
Require the exact accepted length for that type, retain the device ID as two opaque bytes, and decode all multibyte measurement fields little-endian.
steps.expect: Temperature, humidity, and (type 08 only) CO2 values follow the exact rational conversions in protocol_details.

steps.action: Continue across advertisement gaps without substituting values; a connected gadget stops advertising until its client disconnects.

setup.notes: Passive readings need no provisioning or pairing. Logger access is an optional connected operation, not onboarding. Confidence is medium because the flow comes from official public protocol material, not a hardware run here.

rejoin.notes: These gadgets join no Wi-Fi network and passive clients hold no bond. Resume scanning with a new phone. For connected history, disconnect the previous central first; any product-specific bond requirement remains unestablished below.

testing.notes: No physical scan, GATT connection, logger download, pairing, reset, or firmware operation was performed for this spec on 2026-11-11. The advertisement layouts come from Sensirion's protocol document and current public protocol definitions; logger differences are scoped to the cited official generations. The independent tests use invented packets only.

variants.notes: Newer SHT3x-based gadgets emitting advertisement 00 04. This variant does NOT include the legacy SHT31 Smart Gadget / Smart Humigadget, whose connected-only float32 protocol has its own spec.
Temperature and humidity using advertisement 00 06; also known as SHT43-DB.

MyCO2 / CO2 Minion temperature, humidity, and CO2 using the deprecated but still documented advertisement 00 08. Current definitions prefer type 10 for new designs; type 10 is outside this spec's claimed scope.

ArduinoLoggerHeader.description: The first 20-byte transfer frame in the current Arduino generation; offsets are source-derived, not claimed for every PDF device.

fields.description: uint16 LE; 0 SHT3x, 5 SHT4x, 7 legacy MyCO2 with reserved word, or 9 current MyCO2.
fields.name: download_sample_type

fields.description: uint32 LE milliseconds from the latest stored sample to header construction.
fields.name: age_of_latest_sample_ms

fields.description: uint16 LE number of samples in this transfer.
fields.name: download_sample_count

parse_rules: The first frame is the header. Current source zero-initializes bytes 0-3 and 16-19; treat them as reserved.
Subsequent frames carry int16 LE sequence at offset 0 (starting at 1) and sample bytes at offset 2, padded to 20 bytes.

Samples are emitted oldest-to-newest within the selected range. For zero-based sample i of download_sample_count N, timestamp_ms = header_received_epoch_ms - age_of_latest_sample_ms - (N - 1 - i) * interval_ms. Host reception time is an approximation that omits radio latency.

SensirionPassiveAdvertisement.description: Manufacturer-data VALUE after the two-byte company ID. The first two payload bytes are advertisement type 00 and the sample type. See protocol_details.advertisement_formats for the executable offsets, lengths, endianness, and exact rational conversions.

fields.description: Must be 0x00 for all three formats.
fields.name: advertisement_type

fields.description: Two opaque bytes; retain as hex, never as a model or a numeric tick field.
fields.name: device_id

fields.description: uint16 LE; types 04/08 use 100 * ticks / 65535 percent, type 06 uses -6 + 125 * ticks / 65535 percent.
fields.name: humidity_ticks

fields.description: Type 08 only: uint16 LE directly in ppm, with no scaling.
fields.name: co2_ppm

parse_rules: Types 04 and 06 require exactly 8 bytes after the company ID; type 08 accepts exactly 10 or 12 bytes.
For type 08, bytes 10-11 are reserved and ignored when present; current definitions permit omitting them, while the 2022 PDF shows them.
Do not round or clamp as part of wire decoding. Display rounding and physical validity are separate decisions.
Do not use the two-byte ID to select a model or to join readings across changing addresses.

type_4.family: SHT3x-based newer gadgets; not the SHT31 Smart Humigadget

type_8.status: Deprecated by current definitions, which recommend type 10 for new designs; retained for existing units.

connection_behavior.passive_reader_rule: Tolerate the connection gap, retain the last measurement as stale rather than zero, and resume after disconnect.

type_9.publication_note: The 2022 PDF's type-9 diagram misprints 0x0002; the current public type table confirms 0x0009.

requested_samples.note: Differs from the uint16 document tables; deliberately no universal command.

arduino_1_5_0.timestamp_rule: For zero-based transferred sample i of N, timestamp_ms = header_received_epoch_ms - age_of_latest_sample_ms - (N - 1 - i) * interval_ms.

publication_defects: Data Transfer is printed with the Requested Samples UUID 8003; the PDF and Arduino implementation use 8004.
The Data Logger rows say all devices while the service application note excludes Smart Humigadget; the exclusion wins.
The relative-humidity row's uint8 label does not describe the legacy float32 firmware; use the separate SHT31 spec.
current_web_2026_04.type_8_status: Deprecated in favor of advertisement type 10; its reserved two bytes may be omitted.

pdf_2022_v1_0_1.requested_count_omitted: Download all samples; no requested-count write is needed.

test_vectors.provenance: All IDs and packets are invented for this spec. Expected temperature/humidity strings are exact rational values, not rounded display values.

remaining_unknowns: No hardware was scanned or driven; all protocol behavior is reported from official documents/source and fixture-tested only.
Exact local names and firmware-to-model mapping must be captured per board; the opaque two-byte ID cannot provide them.
The current web/PDF/Arduino logger discrepancies need per-generation hardware checks, especially requested-count width and notification versus indication delivery.
Product-specific pairing, bonding, factory reset, unpairing, and OTA/DFU entry/recovery are not established; no DFU capability is declared.
Type 10, newer sample families, calibration, and settings/Wi-Fi services are outside the claimed protocol scope.

format.notes: Six address-derived bytes; display only, never publish an owner's value as an example.

services.name: Device Information (generation-dependent)
services.notes: Published for the newer gadget generations, but optional in practice: the current Arduino library's setup path does not create this service. Discover characteristics instead of assuming their presence. Strings are device-specific; no serial or address from a research unit is recorded.

services.name: Battery (generation-dependent)
services.notes: Optional: the Arduino library creates it only when the gadget enables it. The common denominator is a read; current web definitions also list notifications on some products.

set_logging_interval_ms.advanced_reason: Changes the sampling cadence and erases all locally buffered history on current implementations. Download wanted history first; PDF-generation devices may reject the write.
set_logging_interval_ms.description: Set the logging interval on a generation whose discovered characteristic is writable; current implementations erase history on change.

interval_ms.description: Requested interval in milliseconds. No family-wide valid range or zero-value behavior is established; read back the accepted value.

characteristics.name: Logging Interval
characteristics.notes: uint32 little-endian milliseconds. The 2022 PDF exposed read only; current definitions and Arduino source expose read/write. Check the discovered properties. A successful current-generation write erases all logged samples.

characteristics.name: Requested Samples (generation-specific width)
characteristics.notes: OPTIONAL partial-download control; no command is declared because there is no safe universal write. The 2022 PDF specifies a write-only uint16. The current web table says read/write uint16. The current Arduino write handler instead consumes four little-endian bytes. Omitting this write downloads all available samples. If a bounded download is needed, establish the exact generation first; newer counts select the most recent samples and omit older ones. Do not rely on a read-back: it is not common to all generations.

characteristics.name: Data Transfer
characteristics.notes: Twenty-byte transfer frames. Subscribing starts the download; there is no separate universal start write. The PDF and current source agree on this UUID. The current web table accidentally repeats 8003 for Data Transfer; that duplicate is a publication defect, not an alias to write. Select the delivery exposed by the discovered generation: notifications (CCCD 01 00) where offered, and indications (CCCD 02 00) on current Arduino firmware, which delivers indications even though the PDF describes notifications.

services.name: Data Logger (newer generation only)
services.notes:
Present only on newer gadgets that expose it. The current public table explicitly excludes the Smart Humigadget / SHT3x legacy gadget despite a broad 'all devices' label on individual rows. Do not offer this service for the separate SHT31 Smart Gadget spec.
Full-history download needs no requested-count write: read metadata as needed, subscribe to 00008004-…, and accept a header followed by sample packets. The 2022 PDF says notifications; the current Arduino source sends indications. The exact Arduino header/sample framing is under protocol_details.logger_generations.
